title: As Luck Would Have It Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: "As Luck Would Have It" is a sophisticated 4-story townhome situated in Ruskin Place Park in the heart of Seaside, Florida. With two bedrooms and two and one half baths, this elegant art-filled home sleeps six. Multiple porches overlook the lawn and oak trees of Ruskin Place which is lined with unique boutique stores and art galleries.
description_expanded: 123 QUINCY CIRCLEExperience elevated coastal living at As Luck Would Have It, a refined four-story townhome in Ruskin Place Park, one of the most charming and centrally located neighborhoods in Seaside, Florida. Designed for comfort and style, this two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath residence accommodates up to six guests and offers walkable access to the beach, dining, shopping, and the iconic Seaside town center.Prime Location in Ruskin Place ParkPerfectly positioned at 123 Quincy Circle, this Seaside vacation rental overlooks the lush green lawn and oak-lined park of Ruskin Place—home to local art galleries, boutiques, and seasonal events. Multiple porches provide peaceful park views, while the beach and town square are just a short stroll away, making this an ideal choice for guests seeking a walk-everywhere Seaside escape.Thoughtful Design with Elevator AccessUpon arrival, guests are welcomed into a private foyer featuring elevator access to all levels, making unloading luggage and groceries effortless. An interior staircase complements the elevator, while warm maple hardwood floors extend throughout the home, enhancing the light, coastal aesthetic.Second-Floor Bedroom SuitesThe second level features two beautifully appointed king bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom. The primary suite offers French doors opening to a wrap-around covered porch, a spacious closet, an LCD TV, and a private bath with a walk-in shower. The guest king suite also includes an ensuite bath with a deep shower and pedestal sink. A full laundry room with front-loading washer and dryer is conveniently located on this floor.Open-Concept Living & Gourmet KitchenThe third floor serves as the main living space and includes a convenient powder room. The inviting living room features a comfortable sofa, decorative fireplace, and a large LED TV. French doors open to a covered porch designed for outdoor dining and relaxation, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living.The modern kitchen is thoughtfully designed with a center island and gas range, bar seating, and high-end appliances, including a French-door refrigerator and dishwasher—perfect for preparing meals after a day at the beach.Rooftop Sitting Area & Gulf-View DeckThe fourth floor offers a light-filled sitting area surrounded by windows, complete with a daybed and a small library—an ideal space for reading or relaxing. French doors lead to the private rooftop deck, where loungers invite you to unwind while enjoying sweeping views of Seaside and the Gulf of Mexico. This elevated retreat is perfect for sunrise coffee or sunset cocktails.Your Ideal Seaside, Florida GetawayWith its prime Ruskin Place location, private elevator, multiple outdoor living spaces, and stunning rooftop views, As Luck Would Have It delivers a refined Seaside vacation experience. Just steps from the beach, dining, shopping, and art-filled streets of Seaside, Florida, this townhome is the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm.5-night minimum Summer; 3-night minimum Fall. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. (Only available for rent from Memorial Day through Oct. 1st) FEATURES3,396 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space across four levelsSeaside Beach Access at Coleman PavilionLocated just 176 yards (approximately a 3-minute walk) to beach accessPrivate elevator with access to all floorsRooftop deck with elevated views of Seaside and the GulfAdditional parking available in the lot next to Early Morning HoursStreet parking available along Quincy Circle; additional vehicles may park in paid parking at the daily ratePeacock Alley linens featured throughout the home, including luxurious sheets and plush towelsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts, and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking passes: One pass issued for one-bedroom cottages; two passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes (golf carts are considered vehicles)Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners in Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
